outcome_lines: Treat the comparison as a material model-family divergence and review residence-time assumptions, equation traces, and applicability before preferring the experimental family.
recommended_actions: Treat the candidate family as experimental and keep the default reference family as the screening baseline unless the transport question clearly requires the candidate assumptions.
Review the dominant surface deltas, residence-time assumptions, and equation traces before choosing which family better matches the decision context.
Use this comparison profile when the reference family is the screening baseline and the advective family is being challenged on the same scenario.
Interpret the candidate family as experimental and non-default even when the comparison shows material differences.
Escalate to richer transport methods when the decision context is dominated by spatial hydrodynamics or intermedia transfer.

brief_template_used: Summarize whether the experimental advective family materially changes the screening interpretation relative to the corrected reference family for the same scenario.

limitations.message: Model-family comparison reflects deterministic Environmental Fate MCP outputs for one matched scenario and does not by itself endorse either family as the scientifically correct choice.
Candidate model family advective_screening_mass_balance is published as experimental and should be treated as a challenge path rather than a default release baseline.
